rows.text: CloudSuite v4.2 broke our SAP ERP synchronization. We cannot complete our financial reconciliation.
Support takes days to respond to connector timeout tickets. Our upcoming enterprise renewal is on hold.
AnalyticsPro query performance has improved significantly. Great ROI for our analytics team.
SecurityShield works well across all APAC branches, no complaints.
Saw CloudApex offering discounts, but honestly if NovaCommerce just fixed the ERP sync bug we would stay.
Renewal pricing is slightly higher than expected, but product stability is solid.
